verdict.rationale: GitHub does ship an official CLI (cli.github.com), confirmed by probe evidence, which is a baseline agentic/automation tool for AI-native workflows. However, the evidence pack gives no detail on AI-specific CLI features (e.g., Copilot-in-CLI, agent mode, MCP integration via CLI) beyond the bare existence of the tool. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-native CLI capabilities (Copilot CLI commands, agent workflows), independent hands-on confirmation of AI features in the CLI.
